settings.title: Everything in one box
settings.text: Razor, stand, and 10 blades. Nothing else to buy to get started.

settings.title: Safety guard
settings.text: A guard bar sits under the blade so only the edge meets your skin.

settings.title: Steel handle
settings.text: A knurled grip that stays steady in wet, soapy hands.

settings.title: Blades anywhere
settings.text: Any standard double-edge blade fits. Packs are sold at most drugstores and online.

settings.label: Blades
settings.them: 3 to 5 blades in a plastic head

settings.label: Pressure
settings.them: Often pressed to get a close shave

settings.label: In the box
settings.them: Often one razor and a few cartridges

settings.title: Prepare
settings.text: Shave after a warm shower and use a cream or gel.

settings.title: Find the angle
settings.text: Rest the head flat on your skin, then tilt the handle down until the blade meets it, about 30 degrees.

settings.title: Let it glide
settings.text: Short, light strokes, with the direction of growth first.

settings.title: Finish
settings.text: Rinse with cool water and moisturize. Change the blade every 5 to 7 shaves, and rest the razor on its stand.

settings.a: Most nicks come from pressing down. Hold the razor lightly and keep your strokes short.
Any standard double-edge safety razor blade, 43 mm by 22 mm.
The razor can go in a carry-on. Pack loose blades in checked luggage.
Orders ship in 7 to 15 business days.
